entities.name: PMID:25434319
observations: Kashmir Valley case-control study included 108 gastric-cancer cases and 195 controls; assessed PLCE1 rs2274223, rs3765524, and rs7922612.

Reported haplotypes A-C-T (OR 6.29, corrected P=0.003), G-C-T (OR 3.23, corrected P=0.033), and G-T-C (OR 5.14, corrected P=0.033) as associated with increased gastric-cancer risk; abstract supplied no confidence intervals.

observations: Kashmir Valley study examined PLCE1 variants rs2274223, rs3765524, and rs7922612 in relation to gastric cancer.

entities.name: Gastric cancer
observations: Gastric cancer was the outcome in a Kashmir Valley case-control study of PLCE1 haplotypes.

entities.name: Kashmir PLCE1 haplotypes
observations: In 108 cases and 195 controls from Kashmir Valley, PLCE1 A-C-T, G-C-T, and G-T-C haplotypes had reported increased gastric-cancer odds: OR 6.29, 3.23, and 5.14; corrected P=0.003, 0.033, and 0.033, respectively. Confidence intervals were not available in the retrieved abstract.
Independent replication of these haplotype findings was not found; an Iranian study's null finding for rs2274223 alone does not directly test the Kashmir haplotypes.
